blindSummary: Subnational anti-discrimination law here covers gender identity, and this state/province is one of 16 states plus the capital district with 'shield' laws protecting recipients, families and providers of gender-affirming care from civil or criminal actions brought by jurisdictions where such care is banned; 38% of the transgender population aged 13+ lives under a shield law and 56% under none. No adverse measure specific to this state/province is documented beyond the national framework; the only recorded differences from its protective peers concern insurance-coverage details a visitor never encounters.
blindSourceSummaries: July 2026 anti-trans legal-risk assessment map (republication of an activist publication's state-by-state map): scores every state of the country for transgender adults and places this state/province in the map's fifteen-jurisdiction protective grouping, citing regional non-discrimination law, shield/refuge protections enforceable against out-of-state actions, legal reinforcement of care access, and refuge protections for people fleeing restrictive states. The same update moved one sibling state into the map's most severe travel grade (felony bathroom ban, up to 5 years, partially blocked but in force wherever no gender-neutral option exists).

LGBTQ policy-research project equality map (data as of 25 Sep 2026): 16 states plus the capital district have 'shield' laws protecting access to transgender health care - shielding recipients and providers from civil or criminal actions by states where care is banned; 38% of the transgender population (13+) lives under a shield law, 56% under none. This state/province is among the shield-law states cited in its protective grouping.
